batch_observation.branch_takeaway: Batch 5 split the frontier into three useful corners: 21-day smoothing maximized Sharpe at 1.28, 126-day smoothing with the 252-day rank delivered the best Sharpe-preserving polish at 1.25 Sharpe / 0.91 Fitness / 2.96% turnover, and the 63-day smoothing with the 504-day rank delivered the best Fitness and returns at 0.93 Fitness and 7.10% returns. Because no visible Check Submission evidence or non-null subuniverse result appeared, the next step is to probe official testing evidence on the two leading variants before deciding whether one more combined smoothing-plus-504 batch is justified.
